invariants.rationale: The method operates on the map parameter; a non-null map is a likely precondition.
The method immediately dereferences layer via layer.getObjects(); layer should be non-null.
The element parameter is used in a further call and must not be null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
layer.getObjects() is immediately called and passed along; it is expected not to return null.
If layer is null, layer.getObjects() would not be called; otherwise, if layer is not null, getObjects() is safe.
